title: Pre-emptive Abstract Extension Configuration
pattern: Constructing elaborate abstract frameworks and plugin configuration wrappers for an library dependency that has only one implementation.
why_bad: Adds heavy cognitive overhead, indirection, and maintenance costs without actual technical value. It increases structural complexity in pursuit of speculative generality.
detection: The existence of extensive abstract factory structures, traits, and configurations that map to a single concrete operational target.
fix: Code for the immediate requirement; use simple concrete types and inline logic, refactoring to decoupled abstractions only when a second implementation is introduced.
source: Sandi Metz - *Practical Object-oriented Design* (2019, Addison-Wesley).pdf, Chapter 3; Martin Fowler - *Refactoring* (1999, Addison-Wesley Professional).pdf, Chapter 3.
